burnPaths.claim: annihilate is the ONLY entry point reaching _burn
evidence: grep '_burn' over src/ returns exactly one site: src/Antimatter.sol:239, inside annihilate.
OZ ERC20.sol (lib/openzeppelin-contracts/contracts/token/ERC20/ERC20.sol:229) declares _burn as `internal` and NOT virtual; there is no public/external burn on the base.
ERC20Burnable is NOT in the inheritance list (line 22): only ERC20, Ownable, ReentrancyGuard.
Ownable and ReentrancyGuard expose no supply-affecting function (Ownable.sol:56/76/84; ReentrancyGuard exposes only private/internal helpers).
_update (ERC20.sol:176) is virtual but is NOT overridden in Antimatter.sol, so no alternate supply-reduction path exists.
No assembly, no delegatecall, no fallback/receive in Antimatter.sol.
burnPaths.burnDebitedAccount: msg.sender (line 239). No _spendAllowance anywhere in the file — the 0bb82d8 call was deleted; grep '_spendAllowance' over src/ returns zero hits.

sites.guard: reachable only after all annihilate checks + _burn + successful minter.mint + exact-quote match
sites.amount: `amount` = the 18-dec antimatter quantity burned (the antimatter half)

phUSDMintPaths.note: The stablecoin half's phUSD is NOT minted by Antimatter; PhusdStableMinter mints it to Antimatter (PhusdStableMinter.sol:232, recipient = msg.sender = Antimatter) and Antimatter forwards it with safeTransfer at line 261.

checksPhase.check: toStableAmount(stable, amount) -> external staticcalls to minter.stablecoinConfigs and stable.decimals; reverts StablecoinNotRegistered / UnsupportedDecimals / DecimalsUnavailable / DecimalsMismatch / AmountNotRepresentable

firstStateMutation.note: Antimatter's OWN storage (_balances[msg.sender], _totalSupply) is the first and only local state written, and it is written BEFORE any state-changing external call. All external calls made before this point (lines 230, 234) are staticcall-only views.

interactionsPhase.op: stableBefore = IERC20(stable).balanceOf(this)  [view; taken AFTER burn, BEFORE pull]
minter.mint(stable, stableAmount)  [#3 — pulls the stable, deposits to YS, mints phUSD to this]

annihilateOrdering.summary: Strict CEI on Antimatter's own storage: the sole local write (_burn, 239) precedes every state-changing interaction. No Antimatter storage is written after line 239. Whole function is nonReentrant (221).
annihilateOrdering.allowanceSurfaceTouched: stable's allowance(this -> minter) is set to stableAmount at 247 and zeroed at 253. Antimatter's OWN _allowances mapping is never read or written by annihilate.

noUnboundedLoops.note: no for/while/do anywhere in src/Antimatter.sol; approvedMinters() at 192 returns EnumerableSet.values() which copies the set — O(n) memory in an owner-controlled set, view-only, not called on the annihilate path

checkedArithmetic.note: 0.8.27, no unchecked blocks; the only arithmetic is at 256 (subtraction, cannot underflow because phUSD balance is measured monotonically within the call and would revert if it decreased), 263 (amount + mintedForStable), and 297-299

assembly.note: one low-level staticcall at 292, no inline assembly

pausable.note: Antimatter has no pause; pausing lives on PhusdStableMinter (paused, line 204 of the minter) and takes effect as a revert inside minter.mint

weakRandomness.note: no block.timestamp / prevrandao / blockhash / difficulty anywhere in Antimatter.sol

inboundCallbackHooks.note: no ERC721/1155 safe-mint or receive hooks; the untrusted-callback surface is entirely the arbitrary `stable` token address

localInvariants.statement: annihilate debits antimatter from msg.sender and no one else.
localInvariants.basis: verified-by-reading — line 239 is the only _burn and its account operand is literally msg.sender; no _spendAllowance exists in the file.

localInvariants.statement: annihilate debits the stablecoin from msg.sender and no one else.
recipient is only ever credited, never debited.
localInvariants.basis: verified-by-reading — recipient appears only at 223 (zero check), 260 (mint to), 261 (transfer to), 263 (event).

localInvariants.statement: On success the antimatter burned equals `amount` and the phUSD delivered equals amount + mintedForStable.
On success Antimatter's stablecoin balance is exactly what it was before the pull (no residue).
localInvariants.basis: verified-by-reading — post-check at 254 compares against stableBefore captured at 243.

localInvariants.statement: On success Antimatter's phUSD balance is unchanged net: it receives mintedForStable at 251 and forwards exactly mintedForStable at 261.
localInvariants.basis: verified-by-reading, ASSUMES phUSD.transfer moves the full amount (no fee-on-transfer on phUSD) — the transfer result is not re-measured.

localInvariants.statement: The stable allowance Antimatter grants the minter is zeroed before the function returns on the success path.
localInvariants.basis: verified-by-reading (247 set, 253 clear). NOT true on a revert path — but a revert unwinds the approval anyway.

localInvariants.statement: expectedForStable is computed strictly before _burn and before any state-changing external call.
The minter's registered decimals equal the token's self-reported decimals for any successful annihilate.
localInvariants.basis: verified-by-reading (292-295), ASSUMES `stable` reports decimals honestly and consistently within the tx (a token can return different values across calls; only one reading is taken, at 292, and the minter separately re-reads config.decimals inside calculateMintAmount at minter:254).

localInvariants.statement: annihilate cannot succeed on an amount that is not exactly representable in the stable's decimals.

localInvariants.basis: verified-by-reading — 284 destructures only yieldStrategy (idx 0) and decimals (idx 2); `enabled` (idx 3) is discarded. A disabled stablecoin passes toStableAmount and calculateMintAmount and is only rejected inside minter.mint (minter:209, 'Stablecoin minting is paused'), i.e. AFTER the _burn but within the same reverting tx.

localInvariants.statement: annihilate has no owner/minter gate — it is permissionless for any AM holder.
localInvariants.basis: verified-by-reading (221, no modifier other than nonReentrant).

revertConditionsAnnihilate: minter reverts: 'Contract is paused' / 'Amount must be greater than zero' / 'Stablecoin not registered' / 'Stablecoin minting is paused' / 'Daily mint limit exceeded' / YS deposit failure / phUSD mint failure (minter:204-232)
phUSD.mint failure — Antimatter not an authorized IFlax minter or mintVersion stale (260)

externalCalls.measuredAfter: yieldStrategy != 0 and decimals <= 18 are checked; decimals is cross-checked against the token at 292-295

externalCalls.trustLevel: UNTRUSTED (caller supplies `stable`, but it must already be registered by the owner at 285, so effectively owner-gated)
externalCalls.trustedTo: return a 32-byte word equal to the registered decimals
externalCalls.measuredAfter: ok flag, data.length == 32, and equality with registered decimals. Decoded as uint256 so a >255 value fails the equality rather than reverting the decode.

externalCalls.trustedTo: quote the exact phUSD the subsequent minter.mint will produce
externalCalls.measuredAfter: != 0 at 235; and exact equality against the observed delta at 257
difference is the invariant being enforced

externalCalls.trustedTo: move exactly stableAmount and not re-enter
externalCalls.measuredAfter: re-entry blocked by nonReentrant (221); short-transfer surfaces as a revert inside minter.mint (insufficient balance) or as StableNotDeposited (254)

externalCalls.trustedTo: record the allowance; forceApprove tolerates non-standard approve
pull exactly stableAmount, deposit it to the registered yield strategy, and mint calculateMintAmount(...) phUSD to Antimatter
externalCalls.measuredAfter: stable balance restored (254) and phUSD delta == quote (257). The YS deposit itself is NOT verified by Antimatter — Antimatter only observes that the stable left its own balance, not where it went.

externalCalls.trustedTo: mint `amount` phUSD; requires Antimatter to hold IFlax minter authorization at the current mintVersion (IFlax.sol:103)
externalCalls.measuredAfter: NOT measured — the result is assumed. ASSUMED.
NOT re-measured. ASSUMED (no FoT on phUSD).

unverifiedDownstream: PhusdStableMinter -> IYieldStrategy(config.yieldStrategy).deposit(stable, amount, minter) (PhusdStableMinter.sol:229). Requires a prior owner call to approveYS (minter:180) or the deposit reverts. Antimatter has no visibility into this hop.

Antimatter must be authorized on PhusdStableMinter's phUSD? No — the minter mints via IMintableToken(phUSD).mint (minter:232) using the MINTER's own authorization. Antimatter needs its OWN separate IFlax authorization for line 260.

trustAssumptions: phUSD (FlaxToken v2) is a well-behaved 18-decimal ERC20 with no transfer fee and no transfer hooks; Antimatter's phUSD transfer at 261 is not measured.

Antimatter is (and remains) an authorized IFlax minter at the live mintVersion; IFlax.revokeAllMintPrivileges (IFlax.sol:119) would brick annihilate at line 260 after the burn — reverting, so no loss, but a full DoS.
PhusdStableMinter is owner-configured and honest; the only thing Antimatter independently proves about it is the phUSD wiring (145/158) and the two post-conditions at 254/257.
The owner registers only stablecoins whose decimals() is stable across calls and <= 18.
`stable` executes no reentrancy that matters — enforced locally by nonReentrant, and PhusdStableMinter.mint is itself nonReentrant (minter:203).
